substantive_checks.gate_recognition: PASS: for each p dividing the squarefree candidate product B, every representative d=d0+kB remains a nonresidue, so p divides x^2-dy^2 exactly when p divides both x and y; no division by y is used
substantive_checks.nearest_lattice_formula: PASS: the representative norms are t-kq with q=B*y^2, and Euclidean division proves the exact minimum dist(t,qZ)=min(r,q-r)
substantive_checks.positivity_and_uniqueness: PASS: after primitive reduction gcd(T,BY^2)=1; for B>1 this excludes residue zero and, because BY^2 cannot equal 2, excludes a half-spacing tie
substantive_checks.primitive_factorization: PASS: writing x=cX and y=cY with gcd(X,Y)=1 gives gcd(X^2-d0Y^2,BY^2)=1, including the x=0 or y=0 nonzero-coordinate branches
substantive_checks.candidate_valuations: PASS: every representative is c^2 times a B-unit, hence v_p(N_k)=2v_p(c) for every p dividing B and every k
substantive_checks.representative_ideal: PASS: adjacent representatives differ by B*y^2 and their primitive cofactors are coprime to that spacing, so the ideal generated by all representatives is exactly c^2 Z
substantive_checks.bounded_products: PASS within scope: independent same-class products and powers multiply both log height and candidate valuation by the same degree and therefore do not improve the ratio
substantive_checks.covering_barrier: PASS with scope: nearest-lattice balancing is optimal inside one fixed simultaneous-nonresidue CRT class; no conclusion is drawn about changing the local nonresidue choices
substantive_checks.height_audit: PASS: the inherited normalized ratio is H-kappa+1/12=4.07391337077542... and the raw ratio is H/2+1/24=3.20548043938709..., both far above the candidate mass
substantive_checks.capacity_booking: PASS: neither an actual-family phase bound nor a moving-prime bound on gcd(x,y) is proved; the 1/36-per-6M ceiling is unchanged and the new Route-1 booking is zero

strict_scope.proved: Exact optimal representative, primitive candidate valuation, and the one-dimensional spacing barrier for one frozen simultaneous-nonresidue CRT class.
strict_scope.not_excluded: Optimization across distinct CRT classes, an actual-family exponential phase-cancellation theorem, a useful moving-prime gcd theorem, or a genuinely different bounded-degree invariant.
strict_scope.open: Every positive fixed-j1 capacity reduction; the raw 1/36-per-6M ceiling remains retained.
